name: Achan
summary: Jericho's spoil was placed under the ban, devoted wholly to God. Achan took a garment, silver, and a wedge of gold and hid them in his tent. Israel's next battle failed because of it.
offense: He 'saw, coveted, and took,' then buried the goods under his tent. One man's hidden theft brought defeat at Ai and the death of thirty-six soldiers before the cause was found by lot.
judgment: Achan and his household, with the stolen goods, were stoned and burned in the valley of Achor. The accursed thing, once purged, restored Israel's standing.
